{{Otheruses|Polus}}
'''Polus nets''' were unbreakable sacks which one could conceal beneath a cloak.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> [[Ansionian]]s [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]] used a polus net to [[Kidnapping of Barriss Offee|kidnap]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].<ref name="AS" />
